title: Frames until the timer ends
prompt: A timer has time_left seconds and every frame lasts delta seconds. Return how many whole frames fit into the time left. 1 second at 0.25 s per frame is 4 frames.

tests.name: 0.5 s at 0.2 s is 2 whole frames

hints: int() turns a decimal into a whole number.

docs.name: int(number)
docs.what: Returns the number as a whole number, dropping the decimals.

solution:
func frames_left(time_left, delta):
	return int(time_left / delta)
